title: Druqks Paranoia Engine
prompt: aphex twin style from the druqks album
description: A relentless 909-driven IDM track that opens with a sparse kick-and-hihat groove before detonating into cascading snare rolls and frantic ply multiplications. A sawtooth bassline crawls through C minor as its filter sweeps wider with each section, building paranoid tension that only partially releases in the sparse outro.
code:
setcpm(170/4)
arrange(
  [12, stack(
    s("bd ~ ~ bd ~ ~ bd ~").bank("RolandTR909").gain(1.05),
    s("[~ hh]*4").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.55).pan(sine.range(0.3, 0.7)).degradeBy(0.2),
    note("<c2 c2 eb2 g1>*8").s("sawtooth").lpf(sine.slow(8).range(180, 900)).resonance(10).decay(0.1).sustain(0).gain(0.7)
  )],
  [16, stack(
    s("bd*4").bank("RolandTR909").gain(1.1),
    s("sd*8").bank("RolandTR909").ply("<1 1 2 4>").gain(0.6).degradeBy(0.4).pan(sine.range(0.2, 0.8)),
    s("[~ hh]*8").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.55).cut(1).degradeBy(0.3),
    note("<c2 c2 eb2 g1>*8").s("sawtooth").lpf(saw.slow(16).range(300, 2200)).resonance(12).decay(0.12).sustain(0).gain(0.8)
  )],
  [24, stack(
    s("bd*4").bank("RolandTR909").gain(1.15),
    s("sd*16").bank("RolandTR909").ply("<2 4 2 8>").gain(0.55).degradeBy(0.45).pan(sine.fast(2).range(0.15, 0.85)).speed("<1 1.5 2 1>"),
    s("[~ hh]*8").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.6).cut(1).degradeBy(0.25).every(4, x => x.ply(2)),
    s("~ cp ~ cp").bank("RolandTR909").room(0.3).gain(0.6),
    note("<c2 c2 eb2 g1>*8").s("sawtooth").lpf(sine.slow(4).range(400, 2600)).resonance(14).decay(0.12).sustain(0).gain(0.85).every(8, x => x.fast(2))
  )],
  [16, stack(
    s("bd ~ bd ~").bank("RolandTR909").gain(1.1),
    s("sd(7,16)").bank("RolandTR909").ply("<4 2 8 16>").gain(0.5).degradeBy(0.5).pan(rand.range(0.1, 0.9)),
    s("oh*4").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.4).cut(1).degradeBy(0.4),
    note("<c2 g1 eb2 ab1>*4").s("sawtooth").lpf(saw.slow(16).range(2400, 300)).resonance(16).decay(0.2).sustain(0.1).gain(0.7).room(0.3)
  )],
  [12, stack(
    s("bd ~ ~ ~ bd ~ ~ ~").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.95),
    s("[~ hh]*2").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.4).degradeBy(0.5).room(0.4),
    note("<c2 c2 eb2 g1>*4").s("sawtooth").lpf(sine.slow(8).range(180, 700)).resonance(8).decay(0.15).sustain(0).gain(0.6).room(0.3)
  )]
)
